Compose_ReferenceID.inputs:
@{concat(
  formatDateTime(
    coalesce(
      outputs('Get_item_Doc')?['body/Created']

    'yyyyMMdd'

  '-',
  string(coalesce(outputs('Get_item_Doc')?['body/ID'], '0')),
  '-',
  coalesce(triggerBody()?['NewActivityTask']?['CategoryCode'], 'CAT'),
  '-',
  coalesce(triggerBody()?['NewActivityTask']?['SubCategoryCode'], 'SUB'),
  '-',
  string(coalesce(
    outputs('Get_item_Task')?['body/ID'],
    outputs('Create_Task')?['body/ID'],
    '0'
  ))
)}

)
